observations: body L1-L19: the end of de Goeje's letter, begun on p. XXIII; each line opens with a guillemet, and L5 and L16 begin paragraphs inside the entry. «Juynboll», «Batt.», «Ibn Rosteh» (L8, L19), «al-Kharaqī» (L8, L14, L16), «al-Mas‘ūdī» and «al-Battānī» are letter-spaced.
body L2: «١٠» and «٢٢» are pages of the Samaritan Chronicle in Arabic-Indic numerals; the zero of «١٠» is a round dot (1.3 pt) set 2 pt above the baseline.

body L5-L19: the Arabic words are set right to left inside the French lines as printed: «وعرض طريقه» (L5), «طرفه» and «طرفيه» (L6), «عرضـه في الاصل» and «الخليــج البربري» (L7), «طرفه» (L8), «طرفيه» (L9), «الطرف الادنى» (L12), «البحر الاخير» and «الاخضر» at the right end of L13, «الاخير» (L14), «الى طرف» and «الطرف» (L18), «اعني» (L19). The elongated joins of «عرضـه» and «الخليــج» are transcribed with tatweels.

body L7, L12-L14: «الا» at the head of «الاصل», «الادنى», «الاخير» (L13, L14) and «الاخضر» is printed as one sort: the strokes of the lām-alif cross like an X under a forked top, and no separate alif of the article stands before it. The lām-alif standing alone («لا», p. XX, L8) has the ordinary form.
body L8: «٢٦» is the page of the Arabic text (t. III, p. ٢٦, line 5, the Barbarian gulf); its two digits touch at the top.
body L18: a speck (1.0 by 0.7 pt) stands above the stop after «الطرف», which therefore looks like a colon.

body L20: Nallino's corrections of t. I, p. 189, l. 3 (sin m = R tg φ tg δ) and p. 163, l. 24 (sin α = R tg δ cotg ε). With the sine and the tangent both taken to the radius R, R sin m = R tan φ tan δ gives sin m = tg φ tg δ / R, and likewise sin α = tg δ cotg ε / R, as printed here. The signs = are printed long (9.2-11.7 pt).
body L21: on t. I, p. 217, l. 21, 3600″ : 299 = 12″ 12/299, as corrected here; the change of note 5 concerns the century of az-Zarqālī.

body L22-L35: the entry on p. 222, ll. 30-37. «Steinschneider», «Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Fārisī», «Ptolemaei» and «Yaḥyà ibn Abī Manṣūr» are letter-spaced; «Tabula Probata», the title of Steinschneider's article and «Ma‘āriǵ al-fikr al-wahīǵ» are italic. From «Initium» (L28) the quotation opens each line with a guillemet.
body L26: «medietato» is printed so, for «medietate».
body L29-L30: the year 199 of Yazdegerd began on 28 April 830, as printed. A speck stands in the margin before the guillemet of L29; a mark like a tilde over the S of «Solis» (L34) is a speck.
body: the dashes measure 10.2-10.4 pt (L9, L10, L21).

notes_left L1-L9, notes_right L1-L8: five notes in two columns with a thin rule between them, notes 1-2 on the left and 3-5 on the right. «al-Kharaqī», «Suter», «Brockelmann» and «Dorn» are letter-spaced. The dashes of notes_left L6 and L8 measure 6.8 and 7.7 pt.
notes_left L1, L3: a dot above the 1 of «(1)» and a dot above the l of «lo» are specks.
notes_left L9: «t. II p. 235» has no comma after «II».

notes_right L1: «القَهْـقَرَى» has fatḥa on the first qāf, sukūn on the hā’, fatḥa on the second qāf and on the rā’; the elongated join after the hā’ is transcribed with a tatweel. «ردّ» has the shadda.

notes_right L2, L7: the words in Hebrew letters are Arabic words written in Hebrew characters, as in the passage quoted by Steinschneider; they are printed in a square Hebrew type and transcribed with the Hebrew letters as printed: «לנאלהא» and «לנזולהא», «מכאנה» and «מכאנהא».
notes_right L4: a dot under the o of «Solis» is a speck.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
